title: Unit Event — On Your Feet — Episode8 Back Where It Started

meta.Event Outline: After learning the truth behind RAD WEEKEND, Vivid BAD SQUAD are more determined than ever to surpass that legendary night. The group decide to do what they can for the time being, but Kohane's thoughts linger on her former mentor Taiga.

rows.Line: Several dozen minutes later
Airport

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There he goes...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm really glad we came to say goodbye. I feel so much better now that I've gotten everything off my chest...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hehe.
The way you stuck it to him was really cool, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. You think so?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, all things considered, you did a pretty good job for us.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I agree.
However, we have to make what you said a reality now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right! So, let's do just that!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, we did end up cutting class...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Right...
Everyone's probably taking that English quiz right about now...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You seem anxious, Toya...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I think I know how you feel. I also feel kind of bad about everyone else being at school while I'm not.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Really?
I mean, missing one day isn't a huge problem or anything.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it is.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Especially you two, Akito, Shiraishi.
How do either of you expect to make up for the time you've lost today?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Uhh... I'll...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I-It'll all work out in the end, right?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh dear...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I'm going to need to explain why I wasn't at school today to my parents...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm not sure what's going to happen after I tell them...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, right... Your parents might not take this lightly...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wh-What if they stop letting me practice or do anything with you guys...?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I-If they do, we'll go apologize together...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree.
We'll be there if it comes to that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: At the same time, Azusawa, you came because you felt that you had to be here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Even if they do punish you...
I'm sure your parents will understand if you explain how you felt, like you did just now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
R-Right...!
I'll try doing that when I get home...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Anyway, what should we do now...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Even if we hurry back to our schools, we probably won't make it in time for any classes. So, we could head over to...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, why don't we head over to Weekend Garage...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. I kinda want to tell my dad what we just told Uncle Taiga.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, we haven't seen Ken in a little while since we've been meeting in SEKAI recently...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
So, let's go!
A few hours later
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm back!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, huh...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This place looks eerily clean...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...
It's like...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, Dad...!
The sign out front still says, “Open”. What's going on...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Hm? Oh, whoops...
I forgot to flip it around.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Also, you're back already...?
You're not usually back from school this early.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Or were you...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I'm really sorry...!
I suggested to everyone that we go see Taiga at the airport before he left...!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: You suggested it?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I-It's not your fault, Kohane!
It's mine for saying that it was a good idea!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm sorry for skipping school...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
School's where students are supposed to be...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
But there's no use crying over spilled milk.
And I'm sure you all had your reasons...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Still, you really should've asked first. I wouldn't have said no if you could justify why you were going.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Got it...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: By the way, that goes for all of you...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait, so, Dad...
Where'd all the chairs and tables go...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm doing some cleaning.
I was just putting away all the cups...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Putting them away...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: That's right. I'm thinking about closing this place down for a little while.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Closing down?! What do you mean?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: B-But why...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: You're going to surpass RAD WEEKEND, right?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: So, I'm going to help you do that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
You've all made your decision.
Which is why I'm going to do what I can to honor that.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: It's what I owe you for keeping the truth from you for so long...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I'm also doing this for myself.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Just like Nagi placed her faith in the next generation, I want to see what the future has in store for this town...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Which is why I'll be closing this place down for a while.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
I thought about still running breakfast and lunch services, but...
I'm not one to do things halfway. The shop's going to be closed for a while.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: B-But... What about Mom...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I've already spoken to her about this.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: The topic has also been on her mind for some time now. Her words were, “Go. You have a duty to fulfill.”

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: We still have some money saved up from when I was making music. We should be able to get by for a little while.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Plus, I'm more of a player than a coach. I've never been a good teacher, so I need to be prepared to put in as much time as I can.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're serious about this, Dad...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I'm going to take this opportunity to teach you all everything I can.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: In other words, I'm betting on you using all that I have at my disposal.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: However, you're going to have to fully commit yourselves to singing and staying in shape. I'll be running you all ragged until you can't stand any longer, every single day.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Are you prepared for that...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're going to teach...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, that's a no-brainer.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. There's only one answer to that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're on, Dad!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Okay then.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: As of today, this establishment is closed.
se_event_onyourfeet_2023_002

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(It's all going to start again...
Here, at Weekend Garage.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (If An's dad is saying that much, I'm sure practice with him is going to be really demanding.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I might even feel scared and want to give up at times...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Is it really okay for me to go back in there...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No. I already made up my mind that I'd come listen to that song again!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So... I've got to open the door!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I've felt scared by more than a few things along the way.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Even so...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I've been able to see and experience so many new things because I worked up the courage to open that next door.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Some being really happy things.
So, despite being scared, I've always been glad I took the leap.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Which is why I think I'll be okay...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I mean, Miku and the others said so.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You've changed so much, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Singing has become part of your identity.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (This frustration I'm feeling. It fuels me now...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's going to propel me forward!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (As impossibly high as this wall is, we'll find a way over it. Together...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Yes, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Nothing.
It's just... You looked really excited just now!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's because I am...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Then, let's do it!
We're gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND together!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Nothing else I do is ever going to be this fun or exciting...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm so glad I decided to open the door to this place that day. So unbelievably glad...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(We're starting over! Right here!
In the place where my heart raced when I heard An sing.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's do our best, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Movie
